story.soThat: work isn't lost when validation is interrupted

tasks.task: Implement _last_successful_stage() helper (AC: #1) Determine last completed stage based on artifacts Check for logs existence and validity Check for comparison results existence Return appropriate stage to resume from

Implement resume() method in SessionManager (AC: #1, #2) Load session by ID Check if session already COMPLETED (raise ValueError) Handle FAILED status -> reset to last successful stage Set status to IN_PROGRESS Save and return session

Implement artifact detection logic (AC: #2) Check logs directory exists and contains valid logs Check comparison results exist in analysis/ Check findings.yaml for unclassified findings Return what work remains to be done
Add CLI resume command (AC: #3) Add session resume command to cli.py Accept session_id argument Call SessionManager.resume() Display resume status and next step

Write integration tests (AC: #4) Test resume after execution interrupt Test resume after comparison interrupt Test resume after investigation interrupt Test resume of completed session raises error Test resume preserves partial results

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: SessionManager.resume() method implemented - Loads session by ID, validates session is resumable (not COMPLETED), handles FAILED sessions by resetting to last successful stage, returns loaded session ready for continuation
Resume detects completed work - If logs exist and valid skip execution stage, if comparison results exist skip comparison stage, if all findings classified mark complete
CLI session resume command - rustybt-validate session resume session_id outputs "Resuming session X from stage: Y" and shows next step to perform

Integration test verifies resumability scenarios - Interrupt during execution resumes re-execution, interrupt during comparison resumes re-comparison, interrupt during investigation resumes showing pending findings

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR37: System can maintain session state for resumability. Sessions must be resumable from any stage with detection of completed work.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Session directory structure: validation-sessions/{session_id}/ with session.yaml, findings.yaml, logs/ (rustybt.jsonl, backtrader.jsonl), analysis/ (layer_*_report.md). File existence is source of truth for completion.

doc.title: Epic 3: Session Management System
doc.snippet: resume() method loads session, checks if COMPLETED (raise ValueError), resets FAILED to last successful stage, returns session. _last_successful_stage() uses artifact detection.

doc.title: Story 3.1 - Session Progress Tracking
doc.snippet: SessionStage enum and update_stage() method. Stage transitions guide what work needs to be done. FAILED -> Determine _last_successful_stage() -> Reset to that stage.

constraints.constraint: DEPENDS ON Story 3.1 - Requires SessionStage enum and update_stage() method
File existence is source of truth for completion detection

Log resume action for audit trail (Activity logging in Story 3.6)

tests.standards: Use pytest with @pytest.mark.integration for resumability tests. Create test sessions with partial artifacts to simulate interrupts. Use tmp_path fixture for isolated test directories.

ideas.idea: test_resume_loads_session_by_id - Verify resume() calls load_session correctly
test_resume_completed_session_raises_error - Verify ValueError raised for COMPLETED session
test_resume_failed_resets_to_last_stage - Verify FAILED session reset to _last_successful_stage
test_cli_resume_outputs_status - Verify CLI shows "Resuming session X from stage: Y"
test_resume_after_execution_interrupt - Integration test simulating execution failure
test_resume_after_comparison_interrupt - Integration test simulating comparison failure
test_resume_preserves_partial_results - Verify existing artifacts not deleted
